reasoning: Every finding is answered: the marker/silence boundary rests on observed git states and cited git and POSIX sources, each scenario maps to a test with RED shown first, and the PR body carries every accepted residual in design Risks.

simpler.evidence: design.md Decisions 1, 2 and 4 compare the possible boundaries. A broader substring would silence the broken-worktree case. Walking parent directories would re-implement git's discovery. A marker for a file inside .git/ is rejected because the agent cannot act on it. Every failure being a marker is ruled out by Goals. The classification stays inside the existing adopted_root and adds no new script or indirection.

map.evidence: All 8 delta scenarios appear in tasks.md 'Scenario → test map'. The extended 'File outside an adopted repository' (no repository, a file inside .git, not adopted) maps to test_file_outside_adopted_repository_is_silent, whose cases are no-repo, not-adopted and the new git-dir case from task 1.1. 'Git fails inside a repository' maps to test_git_failure_inside_a_repository_is_visible, with one parameter for each of its three causes.

red.evidence: Task 1.1 writes the new parametrized test and task 1.2 runs check_red, expecting 'RED: 3 failed'. All three states exit 128 today, and edit_lint.py line 44 turns that into exit 0. The added git-dir case passes before and after the change, and task 1.1 says so: it guards Decisions 1 and 2 rather than proving RED, so it correctly stays out of the check_red node id.

platform.evidence: The proposal's Why table now records the .git/ work-tree case (`fatal: this operation must be run in a work tree`, exit 128 on 2.45.1.windows.1), which matches my own run of `git -C r/.git`, `r/.git/hooks`, a bare repository and core.bare=true. Decision 1 cites the GIT_DIR_HIT_CEILING and GIT_DIR_HIT_MOUNT_POINT die calls of setup_git_directory_gently() in git v2.45.1 setup.c. Decision 3 cites POSIX XBD 8.2 for LC_ALL precedence and removes LANGUAGE instead of relying on gettext. Decision 6 observes GIT_TEST_ASSUME_DIFFERENT_OWNER. Each platform behaviour now has an observation or a cited reference next to it. Decision 2 now places the work-tree message in builtin/rev-parse.c for `rev-parse --show-toplevel`, which matches git's source.

replaced.evidence: No project-declared input is replaced and no guard is dropped. The silent branch now covers two named git messages instead of every non-zero exit. git's environment gains LC_ALL=C and loses LANGUAGE (Decision 3), which only changes the language of the messages being classified. The None check for captured output moves earlier and is kept (Decision 5).

catcher.evidence: Risk 'reworded discovery message': the catcher is test_file_outside_adopted_repository_is_silent[no-repo]. It runs under `python .agent-process/scripts/ci_check.py` in .github/workflows/quality.yml on ubuntu-latest, on the PR head. The accepted residuals with no catcher (invalid HEAD, core.bare=true silence, locale pinning untested on ubuntu-latest) are each listed in task 4.2's PR-body residuals, so the person who merges sees all of them.

length.evidence: Changes to the spec relative to openspec/specs/distribution/spec.md: the no-output sentence becomes 'A file for which git finds no repository, a file inside a git directory, or a file in a repository without ... SHALL produce no output' (25 words), and the test's three cases (no-repo, git-dir, not-adopted) assert every clause as exit 0 with empty stdout and stderr. The new marker sentence (32 words) is fully asserted by test_git_failure_inside_a_repository_is_visible through exit 2, 'edit-time lint is not active:' and git's message. The extended WHEN of 'File outside an adopted repository' adds 7 words, asserted by the git-dir case. The new scenario has a 30-word WHEN, one test parameter per cause, and a 16-word THEN that is fully asserted. No rule text is added.

bespoke.evidence: The plan adds no script or check. The two stderr prefixes are branches inside the existing adopted_root of skills/agent-process/scripts/edit_lint.py. Design Context and Decision 1 record why git's exit code, the standard signal, cannot separate the cases, and the proposal's reproduction table backs that up.
